title: Kuwait-flagged tanker KAZIMAH III hit in Strait of Hormuz
excerpt: Kuwait-flagged tanker KAZIMAH III was struck by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz on 1 October, starting a fire, UKMTO said. Crew reported safe.
